kpis.name: Competitor Count
kpis.description: Number of competitors identified and profiled
kpis.rationale: Identified 8 competitors across all categories, within optimal 3-10 range. Distribution ensures comprehensive market coverage: direct competitors (same solution approach), indirect competitors (different approaches to same problem), and adjacent competitors (related capabilities).

kpis.name: Coverage Quality
kpis.description: Percentage of competitors with complete profiles (all 4 dimensions)

dimensions_tracked: Solution Approach (Core product, Key features, Technology)

kpis.rationale: All 8 competitors have complete 4-dimension profiles with verified sources. Each profile includes company overview (funding, size, location), target customer (ICP, segments, verticals), solution approach (features, technology), and positioning (value prop, pricing, differentiation). Average 3.1 sources cited per competitor.

overall_verdict.summary: Recipe 5.1 Competitor List achieves PASS verdict with 2/2 KPIs met. Identified 8 competitors (optimal range) with 100% profile completeness. Competitive landscape reveals 10Demo's unique positioning as the only AI-led conversational demo platform, with clear differentiation from pre-recorded demos (Navattic, Storylane) and human-dependent live demos (Saleo).
key_findings: Blue ocean opportunity: No direct competitor offers AI-led autonomous demo conversations
Market validation: $200M+ total funding across competitors proves robust market
Pricing positioning: $15K-$25K annual target positions between SMB ($6K-$10K) and enterprise ($50K-$100K+)
Strategic differentiation: Zero setup time, 24/7 availability, conversational AI vs. pre-recorded or human-led demos
Clear competitive advantages: AI autonomy, instant deployment (API vs. product cloning), unlimited scalability
strategic_implications: 10Demo is creating a new category within demo automation (AI-led conversational demos)
Mid-market SaaS (100-500 employees) is optimal ICP - underserved by expensive enterprise tools
Integration partnerships with Demodesk/Drift could accelerate GTM
Storylane is closest competitor threat (AI features like voice/translation) - monitor closely
Table-stakes features needed: CRM integration, analytics dashboard, personalization tokens

feature_gap_questions: What features do Storylane/Navattic offer that are table-stakes for 10Demo MVP?
What personalization capabilities (dynamic tokens, branching logic) do prospects expect?
What analytics/reporting metrics do sales leaders need? (engagement time, drop-off points, conversion rates)
What CRM integrations are non-negotiable for mid-market SaaS buyers? (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive)
How do competitors handle complex multi-step product workflows and navigation?

pricing_strategy_input.rationale: Premium to SMB tools (AI innovation value) but accessible vs. $50K+ enterprise platforms. Benchmark: Storylane ($10K-$20K) + 30% AI premium.
value_justification: Zero setup time (no product cloning = faster ROI)
Unlimited demos (no marginal cost per demo)
Built-in lead qualification (AI assesses buyer intent)
